_comment: Provider registry. Each entry is data only -- no R code. The `api_type` field selects which generic caller in R/llm_api.R handles it: 'openai_chat' (OpenAI, Grok, Sarvam, LM Studio, Ollama, and ANY OpenAI-compatible endpoint), 'anthropic' (Claude), or 'gemini' (Google). To add an OpenAI-compatible provider you ONLY edit this file. Adding a genuinely new API shape needs a new caller + api_type in R/llm_api.R. OPTIONAL `max_tokens`: a per-provider OUTPUT-token CEILING -- the app clamps EVERY request (agent turns AND meta-calls) down to it. Remove the field to use only the sidebar slider. The values below are conservative, non-restrictive defaults (>= the sidebar's 4000 ceiling); set each to your model's real documented output limit. NOTE: if a provider is used for Planner/Moderator/Consensus, keep its ceiling >= 3500, since those structured-JSON calls request up to that much.

providers.label: Celeris
providers._note: Base URL is https://inference.celeris.ai/celeris-1/v1 ; the OpenAI-compatible chat route appends /chat/completions. Key `celeris` is in config/secrets.R (or set env var CELERIS_API_KEY).

providers.label: DeepSeek
providers._note: OpenAI-compatible. deepseek-chat = V3 (non-reasoning); deepseek-reasoner = R1 (reasoning, burns hidden tokens -> keep Max Tokens high). DeepSeek does NOT accept an OpenAI-style reasoning_effort param, so reasoning_effort_levels is intentionally empty. Key `deepseek` in config/secrets.R or env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

providers.label: Mistral AI
providers._note: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Key `mistral` in config/secrets.R or env MISTRAL_API_KEY.

providers.label: Perplexity (Sonar / web)
providers._note: OpenAI-compatible, WEB-CONNECTED. Returns live citations, which the openai_chat handler appends to the turn as a 'Sources:' list. Bills a per-REQUEST search fee ON TOP of tokens (see pricing.json `request`). Best used as a research / fact-check PARTICIPANT -- its online models are not tuned for strict JSON, so it is intentionally excluded from Planner/Moderator/Synthesis failover and from auto agent-failover. Key `perplexity` in config/secrets.R or env PERPLEXITY_API_KEY.

providers.label: Local (Ollama / OpenAI-compatible)
providers._note: Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (no key). Model names MUST match an `ollama list` tag EXACTLY (e.g. 'qwen2.5:7b', not 'qwen2.5'). Add whatever you have pulled. NOTE: Ollama serves with a default context (num_ctx, often 4096) that can be smaller than the model's max -- long prompts may be truncated; raise num_ctx in your Ollama/Modelfile settings if needed.
